programs.title: Peace, Justice & Social Harmony
programs.shortDescription: Advancing communal harmony, nonviolent democratic advocacy, and inter-faith dialogue.
programs.fullDescription: Promoting mutual respect, justice, and nonviolent social change across Kashmir through peaceful rallies, candlelight protests, mass signature campaigns, and consultative roundtables with senior religious scholars and community elders. Documented initiatives include the Peace with Justice rally, Candlelight Vigils, Signature Drives, and High-Level De-Radicalization dialogues.
objectives: Organize Youth Peace Circles, candlelight solidarity vigils, and restorative mediation forums.
Conduct consultative conferences with respected Imams and scholars on de-radicalization.
Mobilize students and citizens through mass signature campaigns for peaceful coexistence.
programs.beneficiariesTarget: Community elders, youth councils, inter-faith scholars & civic groups

programs.title: Disaster Relief & Healthcare Outreach
programs.shortDescription: Emergency flood rescue, free specialist medical camps, and menstrual hygiene dignity.
programs.fullDescription: Serving as frontline first-responders during catastrophic crises such as the 2014 Kashmir floods, organizing free diagnostic health camps with prescription drug dispensaries, and breaking taboos through the "Wings of Hope" women’s menstrual hygiene and dignity distribution drive.
objectives: Deploy rapid volunteer response teams during seasonal climate disasters and flood emergencies.
Provide free doctor consultations, diagnostic checkups, and prescription medicines to rural families.
Distribute menstrual hygiene packages and conduct adolescent reproductive health workshops.
programs.beneficiariesTarget: Flood survivors, rural patients, elderly citizens, and schoolgirls

programs.title: Substance Abuse Prevention & De-Addiction
programs.shortDescription: Confronting youth addiction through clinical guidance, legal awareness, and faith alliances.
programs.fullDescription: Tackling Kashmir’s substance abuse crisis through community-based awareness camps, training on the HIV Act 2017, and pioneering partnerships with the J&K Imam Association to mobilize mosques and communities toward early intervention and rehabilitation.
objectives: Conduct grassroots awareness cum training seminars on the HIV Act 2017 and addiction risks.
Forge coalitions with religious scholars and Imams to counsel youth from mosque pulpits.
Provide compassionate counseling and refer affected youth to structured rehabilitation facilities.
programs.beneficiariesTarget: At-risk youth, recovering individuals, families & religious leaders

programs.title: Women & Girl Child Empowerment
programs.shortDescription: Fostering academic confidence, gender equality, leadership, and martial arts self-defense.
programs.fullDescription: Empowering young girls and women through commemorative leadership assemblies, academic award ceremonies, and championship martial arts training (Budokan Karate) that instills physical discipline, mental poise, and self-defense skills.
objectives: Celebrate Women Empowerment Day with leadership summits, awards, and community dialogues.
Sponsor martial arts and self-defense championships for young school and college girls.
Promote equal opportunities in education, public speaking, and youth civic representation.
programs.beneficiariesTarget: School and college girls, young female athletes, women entrepreneurs

programs.title: Youth Leadership, Sports & Culture
programs.shortDescription: Building character and talent through athletic meets, debate championships, and trekking.
programs.fullDescription: Channeling young energy constructively through “Jawan Aur Awam” sports festivals, parliamentary debate tournaments at Sherwani Hall, high-altitude wilderness trekking expeditions with summit flag ceremonies, and Kashmir’s Got Talent cultural showcases.
objectives: Host multi-sport community festivals ("Jawan Aur Awam Aman Hai Makaam") featuring running, carom, and games.
Organize competitive debate championships ("Encounter of Polemics") in collaboration with Municipal Councils.
Lead wilderness trekking expeditions that build physical endurance, team morale, and civic pride.
Stage performing arts and talent hunts celebrating young musical, artistic, and literary talents.
programs.beneficiariesTarget: Student debaters, athletes, trekkers, and performing artists

programs.title: Environmental Stewardship & Climate Action
programs.shortDescription: Promoting school afforestation, native sapling plantations, and climate awareness.
programs.fullDescription: Inspiring future generations to care for the earth through comprehensive tree-plantation drives across government schools and rural zones, teaching students the vital importance of biodiversity, green cover, and climate action.
objectives: Conduct school-wide plantation drives planting native pine, cedar, and shade saplings.
Educate students on environmental balance, climate change mitigation, and conservation.
Establish student eco-clubs to nurture planted trees and preserve campus biodiversity.
programs.beneficiariesTarget: School students, teachers, local communities, and rural habitats

events.title: STANDING WITH THE PEOPLE DURING THE 2014 FLOODS
events.subheading: Humanitarian Flood Relief, Rescue & Rehabilitation Operations
banners: FLOOD RELIEF & HUMANITARIAN ACTION - GYF RESCUE TEAM
events.description: During the devastating floods of 2014, when many families were stranded and homes were damaged, Global Youth Foundation (GYF) stepped forward to stand with the affected communities. Under the leadership of Touseef Raina, our team personally visited flood-affected areas to assess the ground situation and extend immediate support.
events.fullDetails:
During the devastating floods of 2014, when many families were stranded and homes were damaged, Global Youth Foundation (GYF) stepped forward to stand with the affected communities. Under the leadership of Touseef Raina, our team personally visited flood-affected areas to assess the ground situation and extend immediate support.

The images reflect those difficult days damaged houses, distressed families, and communities struggling to recover. GYF volunteers reached out to the affected households, listened to their concerns, and provided relief assistance and moral support at a time when it was needed most.

Our visit was not just about distributing aid; it was about solidarity. We stood with families in their villages, shared their pain, and reassured them that they were not alone. Through coordinated efforts, community support, and volunteer engagement, GYF contributed to relief and rehabilitation efforts during one of the most challenging times in the region.

The 2014 floods remain a reminder of resilience, unity, and the importance of timely humanitarian response values that continue to guide our mission today.

The Global Youth Foundation recently organized a community engagement program under its ongoing campaign “Jawan Aur Awam Aman Hai Makaam,” reaffirming its commitment to fostering trust, harmony, and meaningful connections among young people and the wider community.

The program brought together school children, predominantly young girls along with several boys, who participated enthusiastically alongside GYF volunteers. Gathered under the Foundation’s banner in an open and welcoming setting, the children shared moments of joy, interaction, and collective spirit that reflected the essence of the campaign.

A series of recreational activities formed the core of the event. The emphasis remained on participation, confidence building, and creating a safe space where children could express themselves freely while learning the values of unity and mutual respect.

Through such initiatives, GYF continues to promote peace building, community cohesion, and the empowerment of young girls. The Foundation extends its sincere appreciation to the participating children, dedicated volunteers, and local supporters whose cooperation made the program a success. These efforts remain central to GYF’s vision of nurturing a more harmonious and progressive society.

events.title: TOWARDS A DRUG FREE SOCIETY: A STEP FORWARD BY GLOBAL YOUTH FOUNDATION

events.fullDetails:
The Global Youth Foundation organized an awareness programme focused on addressing the growing concern of drug addiction and its impact on youth and society. The initiative was aimed at educating young people about the physical, psychological, and social consequences of substance abuse, while encouraging a culture of prevention, responsibility, and informed decision making.

The programme brought together students, community members, and volunteers who participated in interactive sessions and open discussions. Resource persons highlighted the serious health risks associated with drug dependency and emphasized the importance of early awareness, strong family support, and positive peer influence. Participants were encouraged to speak openly about the challenges faced by young people and the pressures that can lead to harmful choices.

Through this initiative, the Foundation reinforced the message that awareness and community engagement are powerful tools in combating addiction. By promoting healthy lifestyles, constructive activities, and strong support systems, GYF continues to work toward safeguarding the future of our youth.
